profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Moloco
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with a broad set of technical skills in various fields:
    - Building an account security system that protect billions of accounts from being compromised
    - Building a payment system of ecommerce market on a cloud platform
    - Building an OEM Android framework/build system shipped to mobile products
    - Building several Android applications

 
I specialize in Java/Kotlin and have lots of professional experience working with system-wide design, implementation, debugging and optimization.
I have various experiences from client applications to a large scale server system.
I have communication skills accumulated by leading several projects as a technical leader.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Expert in Meta Accounts Growth

- Drove +3M annual user growth across login and registration flows by reducing friction in benign user funnels through data-driven UX and infrastructure improvements.
- Recovered ~12K daily active users (+40% benign growth lift) by refining scraping detection to better distinguish legitimate users from automated abuse, validated via A/B testing with anti-abuse partners.
- Designed and built end-to-end notification testing framework, enabling safe shipping across email and SMS account-recovery flows used by Meta users.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Expert in Meta Accounts Safety
- Mitigated billions of bot-driven scraping attacks on registration flows, driving a ~99% reduction in fake-account confirmations by architecting and rolling out a state-enforcement framework with integrity team partners.
- Eliminated tens of millions in revenue leakage across Meta accounts by designing and deploying an event-based detection and prevention system for compromised account behavior.
- Defended high-value business accounts against emerging malware threats by building a real-time, ML-driven detection pipeline that continuously analyzes 15+ million daily user events to surface sophisticated attack patterns.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Skilled Backend Engineer, Design, Implement and Operate payment service:

- Develop a payment system processing  massive volume transactions up to 12M traffics per day
- Design and Provide robust APIs dealing with hundreds of thousands requests
- Measure the performance of payment system in various aspects and Optimize the application to - meet certain criteria
- Debug and Tune a RDBMS query to handle billions data
- Write, test, and review codes with clean code principles
- Build and Employ state-of-the-art CI/CD pipeline
positions.insights: Skills: Back-End Web Development · FinTech · Large Scale Systems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full Stack Mobile Software Engineer, I specialized in following works:

- Expertise in Android Framework
- Build/Develop/Release prod applications in MVP/MVVM architecture
- Strong experienced with the latest developing Android mobile application technologies stack. (Currently, Kotlin/Jetpack/Flutter)
- Write Unit-test code for robustness, including edge cases, usability, and general reliability(using JUnit, Mockito and Espresso).
- Release with Crashlytics and Integrate it to internal server to automatically monitor/report live issues.
- Build a continuous delivery pipeline using Jenkins.
- Log user actions in order to provide an advanced feature by various A/B testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Back-End Web Development · Large Scale Systems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Architect of Project Treble in LG
- Analyzed Treble changes which introduced from Android O OS.
- Prioritize changes and Provide detail technical solutions as LG internal documents and seminar

LG Android Platform Architect / Android Framework Engineer
- Leading LG device bring up with multiple chipset releases.
- Leading LG Android common baseline platform.
- Debugging and Troubleshooting issues in system-wide. (Application, Framework, and Build System)
- Review 3~5 LG API commits daily.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

2012 - 2014: Designed / Developed LG Device Management Client Application that provides Device Configuration and Software Upgrades(FOTA) based on the standard protocol OMA DM 1.2
